title: §7 critic-calibration gate — did the loss-side blindness move? (gen-12 vs gen-13)
registration: gen13_endofrun_runbook.md §7 (added mid-run, before any gen-13 calibration number existed)
method_rules_honoured: gen-12's number read FIRST, same script version, same flags, same trace tier (like-for-like)
selection-free: pivots evenly spaced through the eligible window by POSITION only, never by badness
battle-CLUSTERED bootstrap: decisions inside one battle share a board/matchup/opponent, so resampling decisions would report a CI far too narrow

7a_awareness.reading: FLAT to slightly worse. blind_loss moves 0.002 on n~1350 (noise); cap_aware 0.800->0.667 is 12/15 vs 6/9 and carries no weight at that n. Nothing improved.

7b_rollout_pit.filters: LOSSES only, battle >= 50 game turns, decision at turn >= 30, 3 evenly-spaced pivots/battle, 8 rollouts each

confident_band_wp_0.70_to_1.0.why: the registered n>=25 was specified on DECISIONS, but reading (ii) lives on the win_prob>=0.7 SUBSET, which was only 7 and 3 in the broad sample. Re-sampled targeting that band. This is a gap in the REGISTRATION, not in the run.

verdict.result: FAIL — the loss-side over-confidence did NOT improve
two_part: gen-13 IS significantly over-confident on the stall class: mean gap +0.358, CI95 [0.227, 0.504] on the confident band (and +0.205 [0.120, 0.316] on the broad band). Half of its confident stall-loss decisions are blind (0.500, CI [0.290, 0.724]).

gen-13 is NOT separably different from gen-12 on EITHER reading: mean-gap difference +0.080 CI [-0.070, +0.253]; confident-blind difference +0.100 CI [-0.177, +0.394]. The five routes neither fixed the blindness nor measurably worsened it.
verdict.correction_recorded: Reading the two runs' individual CIs would have supported 'gen-13 got worse' (gen-12's touches zero, gen-13's excludes it). Testing the DIFFERENCE refutes that. The individual-CI comparison is the error this entry exists to prevent.
verdict.branch_fired: FAIL with §2 liveness PROVEN — all five routes trained off zero, so this is not 'the routes were never connected'. The delivery line is exhausted; the next work is training-distribution/input, NOT more routes, NOT search, NOT tail-weighting.
